subject.title: Implement RFC 0024 localization runtime and product coverage

question: Should maintainers sponsor the RFC 0024 rollout through the documented dependency chain, and which owner slice is authorized to land next after the shared gates are reviewed?
rationale: The RFC direction is accepted, but this protected tracker coordinates broad runtime, trusted-automation, and owner-surface work that cannot safely be reduced to one autonomous repair.

options.title: Continue staged rollout
options.body: Review and land the shared foundation and catalog gates first, then restack and validate one owner-owned product slice at a time.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Retain the accepted runtime foundation but defer broad surface coverage until a smaller set of priority surfaces and ownership boundaries is approved.

options.title: Pause after the shared gate
options.body: Land no owner slices until maintainers have reviewed a real same-repository catalog refresh and its automation boundary.

recommendation.title: Continue staged rollout
recommendation.body: Review and land the shared foundation and catalog gates first, then restack and validate one owner-owned product slice at a time.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked implementation proposals identify Patrick as the primary reviewer for the rollout stack.
